{{Quote|None of the many frequencies I've exposed the dianoga to have caused any kind of response!|Okara, to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Colony Crisis">{{TCWComicCite|6.48|Colony Crisis}}</ref>}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Okara''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] was stationed at an [[Mon Calamari underwater base|underwater base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Angered by the presence of the base, a [[colony creature]] sent a horde of [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] to [[Attack on the Mon Calamari underwater base|attack]] the facility, and in the aftermath of the raid, Okara performed experiments by exposing dianoga to various different frequencies, in an attempt to determine whether the creatures were being [[Telepathy/Legends|mind-controlled]].
